# Quality Indicator

This folder documents the specific quality indicators used by the Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) to monitor and evaluate the standard of care for patients with inflammatory bowel diseases and primary sclerosing cholangitis. It covers the broad framework of diagnostic, medical, and surgical metrics established by the national steering group to ensure consistent treatment across Denmark's regions. Additionally, it provides a detailed look at the post-surgical re-operation rate, a critical parameter that triggers mandatory internal audits when departments exceed acceptable thresholds.

## Pages

- [[quality-indicator|Quality Indicator]] — Outlines the comprehensive set of DANIBD metrics tracking diagnostic workups, patient education, biologic treatment monitoring, and surgical outcomes across Denmark's regions.
- [[re-operationsrate]] — Details the re-operation rate within 30 days of initial IBD surgery, a key parameter that triggers internal audits when deemed too high by the steering group.
